name: Introduction and overview — Saab Gripen — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — Saab Gripen
description: Introduction and overview of the Saab Gripen: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The Saab Gripen is a single-engine multirole fighter built by Saab, entering Swedish service in 1997. Designed for dispersed operations from short road strips with minimal support, it won export orders from South Africa, Hungary, Czechia, Thailand, and Brazil. About 270 have been built; the Gripen E is the latest version. Baseline facts: Single-engine multirole fighter; Swedish service from 1997; ~270 built by Saab; road-strip operations..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.
key_points: Saab Gripen: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history.
